# Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(nbastatR)
library(cowplot)

Sys.setenv(VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE = 999999)
```

# Create Basketball Court

```{r court-functions}
circle_points <- function(center = c(0, 0), radius = 1, npoints = 360) {
  angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = npoints)

  tibble(
    x = center[1] + radius * cos(angles),
    y = center[2] + radius * sin(angles)
  )
}

# NBA court dimensions
width <- 50
height <- 94 / 2
key_height <- 19
inner_key_width <- 12
outer_key_width <- 16
backboard_width <- 6
backboard_offset <- 4
neck_length <- 0.5
hoop_radius <- 0.75
hoop_center_y <- backboard_offset + neck_length + hoop_radius
three_point_radius <- 23.75
three_point_side_radius <- 22
three_point_side_height <- 14

# Court themes
court_themes <- list(
  light = list(
    court = "floralwhite",
    lines = "#999999",
    text = "#222222"
  ),
  dark = list(
    court = "#000004",
    lines = "#999999",
    text = "#f0f0f0"
  ),
  ppt = list(
    court = "gray20",
    lines = "white",
    text = "#f0f0f0"
  )
)

plot_court <- function(court_theme = court_themes$light,
                       use_short_three = FALSE) {

  three_radius <- three_point_radius
  side_height <- three_point_side_height

  if (use_short_three) {
    three_radius <- 22
    side_height <- 0
  }

  court_points <- tibble(
    x = c(width / 2, width / 2, -width / 2, -width / 2, width / 2),
    y = c(height, 0, 0, height, height),
    desc = "perimeter"
  )

  court_points <- bind_rows(
    court_points,
    tibble(
      x = c(
        outer_key_width / 2,
        outer_key_width / 2,
        -outer_key_width / 2,
        -outer_key_width / 2
      ),
      y = c(0, key_height, key_height, 0),
      desc = "outer_key"
    )
  )

  court_points <- bind_rows(
    court_points,
    tibble(
      x = c(-backboard_width / 2, backboard_width / 2),
      y = c(backboard_offset, backboard_offset),
      desc = "backboard"
    )
  )

  court_points <- bind_rows(
    court_points,
    tibble(
      x = c(0, 0),
      y = c(backboard_offset, backboard_offset + neck_length),
      desc = "neck"
    )
  )

  foul_circle <- circle_points(
    center = c(0, key_height),
    radius = inner_key_width / 2
  )

  foul_circle_top <- foul_circle %>%
    filter(y > key_height) %>%
    mutate(desc = "foul_circle_top")

  foul_circle_bottom <- foul_circle %>%
    filter(y < key_height) %>%
    mutate(
      angle = atan((y - key_height) / x) * 180 / pi,
      angle_group = floor((angle - 5.625) / 11.25),
      desc = paste0("foul_circle_bottom_", angle_group)
    ) %>%
    filter(angle_group %% 2 == 0) %>%
    select(x, y, desc)

  hoop <- circle_points(
    center = c(0, hoop_center_y),
    radius = hoop_radius
  ) %>%
    mutate(desc = "hoop")

  restricted <- circle_points(
    center = c(0, hoop_center_y),
    radius = 4
  ) %>%
    filter(y >= hoop_center_y) %>%
    mutate(desc = "restricted")

  three_point_circle <- circle_points(
    center = c(0, hoop_center_y),
    radius = three_radius
  ) %>%
    filter(
      y >= side_height,
      y >= hoop_center_y
    )

  three_point_line <- tibble(
    x = c(
      three_point_side_radius,
      three_point_side_radius,
      three_point_circle$x,
      -three_point_side_radius,
      -three_point_side_radius
    ),
    y = c(
      0,
      side_height,
      three_point_circle$y,
      side_height,
      0
    ),
    desc = "three_point_line"
  )

  court_points <- bind_rows(
    court_points,
    foul_circle_top,
    foul_circle_bottom,
    hoop,
    restricted,
    three_point_line
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_path(
      data = court_points,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = desc),
      color = court_theme$lines
    ) +
    coord_fixed(
      ylim = c(0, 45),
      xlim = c(-25, 25)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 22) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = court_theme$text),
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = court_theme$court,
        color = court_theme$court
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = court_theme$court,
        color = court_theme$court
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = court_theme$court,
        color = court_theme$court
      ),
      legend.key = element_blank()
    )
}
```

# Kevin Durant NBA Shot Data

```{r durant-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Retrieve Brooklyn Nets playoff shot data
nets <- nbastatR::teams_shots(
  teams = "Brooklyn Nets",
  seasons = 2021,
  season_types = "Playoffs"
)

# Filter for Kevin Durant and convert shot coordinates
durant <- nets %>%
  filter(namePlayer == "Kevin Durant") %>%
  mutate(
    x = as.numeric(as.character(locationX)) / 10,
    y = as.numeric(as.character(locationY)) / 10 + hoop_center_y,
    x = -x
  )

# Game 5 vs. Milwaukee — June 15, 2021
final_durant <- durant %>%
  filter(as.Date(dateGame) == as.Date("2021-06-15"))

# Verify shot data
final_durant %>%
  summarise(
    shot_attempts = n(),
    made_shots = sum(isShotMade, na.rm = TRUE),
    missed_shots = sum(!isShotMade, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# Kevin Durant Shot Chart

```{r durant-chart, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
durant_chart <- plot_court(
  court_theme = court_themes$ppt,
  use_short_three = FALSE
) +
  geom_point(
    data = final_durant,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      color = isShotMade,
      fill = isShotMade
    ),
    size = 3,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "green4",
      "FALSE" = "red3"
    ),
    breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    labels = c("Made", "Missed")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "green2",
      "FALSE" = "gray20"
    ),
    breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    labels = c("Made", "Missed")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(-27.5, 27.5),
    ylim = c(0, 45)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Kevin Durant vs. Milwaukee",
    subtitle = "49 PTS | 17 REB | 10 AST | 4-9 3PT - 6/15/21",
    caption = "Original visualization by Akeem Lawrence | Tutorial inspiration: @DSamangy"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 22,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold",
      color = "white"
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 7,
      color = "lightgrey"
    )
  )

durant_chart
```

# Save Visualization

```{r save-chart, eval=FALSE}
ggsave(
  filename = "kevin-durant-shot-chart.png",
  plot = durant_chart,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "gray20"
)
```
